femto_cross_validation.description: Held-out FEMTO bearings in five outer folds; forecasters, rules and policies see training bearings only.

transfer.description: Forecasters, policies and the indicator Rule fitted on all 17 FEMTO bearings and applied unchanged to XJTU-SY.

age_designs.description: Operating age removed from only the policy or only the forecaster, on held-out FEMTO and after transfer.

forecast_rules.description: One cutoff on the forecast input of Full or No age, fitted for pooled training profit, and the naive cutoff of 12 minutes.

candidate_selection.description: Six held-out FEMTO candidates, three input designs at two training budgets, ranked by pooled held-out calendar profit after averaging the seeds of every bearing.
candidate_selection.selection: Maximum pooled held-out profit, total seed-averaged cash over total seed-averaged calendar minutes; exact ties prefer fewer failures, then the shorter budget, then fewer policy inputs.

risk_classifier.description: A gradient-boosted classifier on the inputs of Full or No age marks every minute at or after the last safe order and orders at the first minute whose score reaches a threshold. The threshold is chosen by pooled training profit on leave-one-bearing-out scores of the training bearings, after which the classifier is refitted on all of them.

rule_search.description: Sixteen rule families: the five indicator families, the same with no order before minute 10, and level, peak and forecast conditions combined with a minimum age or an age limit. Each family is refitted on the training bearings; a family is chosen by inner cross-validation, and, in hindsight, by pooled held-out profit.
